summary: Social platform with posts, polls, groups, and pages features. Currently fixing actor binding errors and broken creation flows for posts, polls, groups, and pages.
architectural_notes: Backend uses canister actors (IC/Internet Computer); actor bindings must be properly wired for posts, polls, groups, and pages
known_issues: Unable to create posts, polls, groups, or pages — likely due to broken canister actor bindings
Actor not found errors displaying in the UI

existing_features.title: Audit and fix the backend actor initialization in useActor.ts-dependent hooks inside useQueries.ts to ensure the actor is always properly instantiated before any mutation or query is called. Guard all backend calls so they wait for a valid actor instance and do not proceed with undefined/null actor.

Fix the post creation flow so that submitting a new post via CreatePostCard, QuickPostBar, CreateGroupPostModal, and SharePage successfully calls the backend createPost method and the new post appears in the feed without errors.

Fix the poll creation flow so that submitting a new poll via CreatePollPage and any poll creation modal correctly calls the backend createPoll method and the new poll appears in PollsPage without errors.

Fix the group creation flow so that submitting a new group via CreateGroupPage and CreateGroupModal correctly calls the backend createGroup method and the new group appears in CommunitiesPage/GroupsPage without errors.

Fix the page creation flow so that submitting a new community page via CreatePagePage correctly calls the backend createPage method and the new page appears in PagesPage/CommunitiesPage without errors.

Remove or suppress all raw actor error messages currently displayed in the UI. Replace any raw canister/actor error display with user-friendly error messages using the existing backendErrors.ts utilities. Errors should be shown as dismissible toast notifications or inline form errors, not as raw technical strings.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix actor binding errors causing posts, polls, groups, and pages creation to fail, and remove actor error displays in UI

Ensure the Motoko backend actor exposes all required update methods for createPost, createPoll, createGroup, and createPage with correct parameter types matching the frontend Candid interface. Verify that the actor interface in main.mo is consistent with what the frontend expects in useQueries.ts.
